dispatch_policy: No more than3 active sector workers. Odd sectors reuse CPUs28/29 only after corresponding even worker termination and PASS. Each worker enforces shared STOP before work and each million pairs. Exactly one execution per sector.
launcher: timeout -s TERM 1215s env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 BLIS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 taskset -c <CPU> /data/code/atomx/.venv/bin/python <absolute_worker> --execute <absolute_root_seal>
measurement_scope: Single source-bound physical diagnostics, not controlled timing or measured parallel speedup.
